message.content:
This editorial illustration features a light teal background. At the top, the masthead "TEMPO" is written in large, teal serif letters. Above this, a red horizontal bar is positioned on the left. Several lines of black text are visible, including "Tembak Mati di Rumah Petinggi Polisi H.76", "Berburu Rente Divestasi Saham Vale H.88", and "DILEMA MELEGALKAN GANJA". A smaller paragraph mentions "Pemerintah Indonesia bimbang mengizinkan kanabis untuk kepentingan medis" and "Thailand". At the bottom, a barcode, QR code, and publication details like "18-24 JULI 2022" and "RP 50.000" are present.

The central graphic depicts a transparent plastic IV bag shaped like a serrated cannabis leaf, hanging from a metal hook on a grey stand. The bag is partially filled with teal liquid. A tube connects the leaf-shaped bag to an IV needle taped to a person's forearm at the bottom right. The hand is clenched, with the thumb tucked under the fingers. The arm is brown-toned. The IV line is white and thin, secured with white medical tape. The composition uses a minimalist, flat graphic style.
